verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that a scheduling link can be connected to a Stripe product and require payment before the meeting time is reserved. The docs also cover accepting any payment method enabled in the connected Stripe account, collecting sales tax via Stripe Tax, and managing offerings and prices natively within SavvyCal. Together these directly deliver payment collection at booking for paid sessions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the payment-at-booking flow (all evidence is vendor-claimed).
